correctness.rationale: The proof reduces covering to a forbidden three-arc directed pattern. For every arc, disjoint in/out neighborhood pairs yield a global 2qE bound, complemented by Cauchy to give E<=q²/2. Even-order equality forces bidirectionality and Mantel equality; odd-order extremizers reduce by removing a degree-(q-1) vertex, whose two independent neighborhoods each saturate one bipartition side and must coincide. The construction attains the bound; orbit enumeration follows. Independent standard-library exhaustive q=2..5 replay confirmed all optimum-layer codebooks, without treating finite checks as infinite proof.
